t: A Quick Guide to Owning the Universe
s: November 20, 2013 - NASA owns every bit of the 840 pounds of the stuff that Apollo astronauts brought back to Earth from 1969 to 1972. Scientists can request bits of lunar material to study, but it’s illegal to own or sell any of it. Those who can afford to buy a piece of space history, however, might get a tiny bit of Moon dust if they buy an object used by one of the Apollo astronauts.
